objective: 可选的周报通知包装图。等待独立 weekly-work-report Graph 完成本地发布，再把报告标题和摘要作为一条文本消息，经操作员授权的企业微信机器人发给指定收件人；不重复采集、写作或评审，不生成新内容。

validate.run:
set -eu
python3 -c '
import json, os
data = json.loads(os.environ["ANCHOR_INPUT"])
for field in ("notify_bot", "notify_userid"):
    value = data.get(field)
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise SystemExit(field + " must be a non-empty string")
'

notify.run:
set -eu
python3 -c '
import json, os, subprocess, sys
data = json.loads(os.environ["ANCHOR_INPUT"])
bot, user = data["notify_bot"].strip(), data["notify_userid"].strip()
lines = open("/in/report/result/report.md", encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
headline = lines[0].lstrip("# ").strip() if lines else ""
body = " ".join(line.strip() for line in lines[1:] if line.strip())[:1200]
message = headline + ("\n\n" + body if body else "")
sent = subprocess.run(
    ["anchor-channel-send", "--bot", bot, "--userid", user],
    input=message.encode("utf-8"), capture_output=True)
sys.stdout.write(sent.stdout.decode("utf-8"))
sys.stderr.write(sent.stderr.decode("utf-8"))
raise SystemExit(sent.returncode)
'
